name: Ruin Demon
tactics: The ruin demon attacks the nearest enemy, flowing over the target as a vile swarm that fills eyes, mouth, and ears. A victim that succumbs to the ruin demon’s vile infestation becomes the swarm’s puppet, flailing about under fiendish control.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

resistances.name: Melee and Ranged
resistances.details: Half damage from melee and ranged attacks

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Swarm Attack
traits.details: Any enemy that starts its turn within the aura takes 10 damage.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.details: The ruin demon swarm can occupy the same space as another creature, and an enemy can enter its space, which is difficult terrain. The swarm cannot be pulled, pushed, or slid by melee or ranged attacks. It can squeeze through any opening that is large enough for at least one of the creatures that comprise it.

auras.name: Swarm Attack

hit.description: The target is dominated and takes ongoing 10 damage (save ends both). The ruin demon enters the target’s square and is removed from play until the effect ends. When the effect ends, the ruin demon appears in an unoccupied square adjacent to the target.
